question: Which of the following is a 'Maharatna' company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• This is the official question asked in RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
 
• According to it Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited is the right answer

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Maharatna is one of the highest statuses granted to public sector enterprises (PSEs) in India.
 
• It allows greater financial autonomy and operational freedom to these companies. 
 
• The Maharatna status is granted by the Government of India to public sector companies that meet certain criteria, including having significant financial strength, substantial revenue, and a large market presence.
 
• Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) was granted the Maharatna status in 2010.
 
• As a Maharatna company, BPCL has been granted enhanced autonomy, especially in terms of decision-making for capital expenditure (up to Rs. 5,000 crore without government approval), making it one of the most prominent public sector enterprises in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Oil India Limited (OIL) became a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) on August 3, 2023
 
• Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) was granted Navratna status in 2008,
 
• Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) became a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) on October 12, 2024.
